course.title: Practical UAV: From Software Engineer to Civil Drone Operator

main.title: Main practical path
main.description: Build, program and fly a real quadcopter. Do these in order.

foundations.title: Optional foundations
foundations.description: Learn a prerequisite exactly when you need it. Skip what you know.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Milestones that prove you can do it, not just that you read it.

modules.title: Orientation — what a UAV actually is
modules.summary: The vocabulary and the mental map of the whole UAV stack, the Hermon plan, and how to study this course with an AI teacher.

modules.title: Flight physics & aerodynamics
modules.summary: The four forces, tilt-to-translate, drag, propeller pumping, hover efficiency, stability, wind and the energy math — everything the later control and endurance lessons stand on.

modules.title: Motors, ESCs & props
modules.summary: The 3-phase BLDC, KV and torque curves, ESC firmware (DShot), prop sizing and matching, a static thrust test rig, efficiency, heat and vibration — ending with the design decision for Hermon's powertrain.

modules.title: Power & energy
modules.summary: LiPo chemistry, pack configuration, C-rating and voltage sag, power distribution, the power budget, monitoring, charging and storage, battery safety, endurance prediction, and buying batteries in the US.

modules.title: Frame & assembly
modules.summary: Frame materials and topology, the mass and centre-of-mass budget, the wiring harness, vibration isolation and the payload bay, the full documented Hermon build, and the pre-flight discipline that keeps it airworthy.

modules.title: Sensors for UAVs
modules.summary: What each sensor buys you, how gyros, accelerometers, magnetometers, barometers, GNSS receivers, optical flow and rangefinders actually work, and the noise, bias, drift, mounting and calibration that decide whether the flight controller can trust them.

modules.title: State estimation
modules.summary: Why the state is never measured directly, how a complementary filter and then a Kalman filter fuse what you do measure, how ArduPilot's EKF3 does it in production, and how to tell from a log whether the estimator is healthy.

modules.title: Control for flight
modules.summary: The cascaded rate–attitude–velocity–position loops that fly a multicopter, how four commands become four motor outputs, why filtering decides how hard you can push the D term, and how to tune Hermon methodically instead of by feel.

modules.title: The flight-controller platform
modules.summary: The autopilot landscape, what is actually inside a flight-controller board, choosing and flashing Hermon's, the MAVLink protocol, the ground stations, and the full data path from a sensor sample to a motor command.

modules.title: Telemetry & datalink
modules.summary: Link budgets in real units, the ExpressLRS control link, what happens when the link drops, MAVLink telemetry constrained to the 917-920 MHz window that is licence-exempt in Israel, and the spectrum rules on both sides of the course.

modules.title: Simulation
modules.summary: A quadcopter simulator you write yourself, the sensor noise and wind that make it honest, ArduPilot's SITL with the real firmware in the loop, Gazebo for the world around it, and the regression matrix that runs while you sleep.

modules.title: First flights & manual piloting
modules.summary: The first power-up-to-hover sequence, the manual modes, the basic manoeuvres, flying in wind, battery discipline in the air, and the emergency procedures you rehearse before you need them.

modules.title: Autonomous flight & mission planning
modules.summary: Missions as lists of waypoints, planning them in a ground station, the geofence and RTL logic that contain them, automatic takeoff and precision landing, and writing your own mission logic in Python.

modules.title: Navigation & GNSS
modules.summary: How satellite positioning actually works, where its errors come from, what RTK and PPK buy you, the coordinate systems an operator must not confuse, and what to do when the signal is degraded, denied or spoofed.

modules.title: Vision & perception
modules.summary: Choosing and calibrating a camera that flies, stabilising it, detecting and tracking objects in the air, turning a pixel into a ground coordinate, and fitting the whole pipeline into a latency budget on the compute you can carry.

modules.title: Onboard autonomy
modules.summary: Putting a companion computer next to the flight controller, bridging MAVLink into ROS 2, commanding the aircraft from your own code, expressing a mission as a behaviour tree, and making the whole thing start itself and fail safely.

modules.title: Flight-test & data analysis
modules.summary: Testing a machine that cannot be paused, building a test matrix, reading flight logs as your primary instrument, injecting failures on purpose, and assembling the evidence that says Hermon is airworthy.

modules.title: Payloads & delivery
modules.summary: What hanging 250 g under an aircraft does to it, release mechanisms you design and build, spray and irrigation payloads, the flight-dynamics upset when the mass leaves, the ballistics of getting it onto a spot, and the Hermon pod build.

modules.title: Civil & public-safety operations
modules.summary: What civil drone work actually is, what the operator does all day, how a mission is planned and briefed, how airspace works in practice, the FAA Part 107 path to a certificate, and how a fleet is kept flying.

modules.title: Capstone — Hermon's mission
modules.summary: One full autonomous mission, flown ten times cleanly, with evidence: take off, survey a field, detect the target, deliver the payload on it, and return to a precision landing.

modules.title: Flight aerodynamics & physics (FA)
modules.summary: The physics a flying machine needs, from zero: vectors and forces, Newton's laws in flight, work, energy and power, and the wind, trajectory and unit maths that the flight lessons assume.

modules.title: Drone electronics & power (FEL)
modules.summary: The electrical half of a drone from zero — voltage and current, DC power maths, lithium-polymer packs, three-phase brushless motors, and the wires, fuses and shunts that connect them.

modules.title: GNSS & navigation maths (FGL)
modules.summary: Where a coordinate actually points — datums and the shape of the Earth, local frames, distance and bearing on a sphere, and the geometry and error analysis behind a satellite fix.

modules.title: RF & datalink (FRA)
modules.summary: Radio from zero for people who ship software — decibels and path loss, the link budget, antennas and polarisation, and the protocols and bands a drone actually uses.

modules.title: Civil operations fundamentals (FOP)
modules.summary: The operational habits that separate a professional from a hobbyist — planning a mission properly, managing risk on paper before it happens in the air, and debriefing honestly afterwards.
